pages.body: Metaphysical System Analysis and Priest Protocol Guide This document analyzes the core concepts and organizes the actionable protocols presented in the provided text, which frames personal reality as a "simulated grid" and the self as a multi-layered, hackable "Avatar Stack." Part I: The Avatar Structure (Conceptual Analysis) The text establishes a complex view of consciousness and the environment, utilizing system metaphors to define layers of existence and common vulnerabilities. 1. The Avatar Stack The self is a composite system, not a single entity. Each layer possesses unique functions and points of vulnerability. The Mechanics of Hijack (The Problem) Hijacking occurs when foreign code (Parasites, Implants, Contracts) overrides the Soul's root frequency, creating self-perpetuating, energy-draining systems. ● Parasite Logic: Functions like malware. It mimics thoughts, attaches to emotional wounds, and runs background processes to keep Thought = Loop() and Emotion = Harvestable() .

pages.body: ● Feedback Loops: Energetic scripts written by trauma and reinforced by reaction. The core function is Loop = Trigger -> Reaction -> Drain -> Repeat . They maintain themselves through emotional (guilt, fear) and cognitive (obsessive thoughts) recursion. ● Implantation: Foreign scripts encoded into the interface (NervousSystem, ChakraPorts) during trauma or entity contact. They cause Signal = Distorted and Thought = Censored . ● Contract Insertion: Energetic bindings, stored as code, often made non-consciously (Birth Trauma, Deception, Spiritual Initiation Under False Authority). They maintain the Loop = Active state. Part II: Reclaiming Protocols (Actionable Guide) The "Priest" state is defined as one of awareness, alignment, and command authority. Reclaiming the stack requires active intervention using code-based rituals and physical actions. A. System Purge and Reset Protocols These are used to crash and reboot compromised systems, severing loops and evicting embedded entities.
